subject: Netzo hands-on prompt lab — timing and pre-checks
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marcus Lee <marcus.lee@netzo.com>
Date: Tue, 07 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Netzo hands-on prompt lab — timing and pre-checks

Hi Ellie / Netzo team,

Thanks again for agreeing to run the hands-on prompt lab as part of the POC. We want this session to be practical — review your prompt inventory, validate routing/guardrails, and run a short load test against a representative workload so we can confirm latency and cost assumptions.

Quick asks before we lock time:
- Can you attach a short prompt inventory (owners + sample prompts + expected structured outputs) — I attached our template to make this faster.
- Do you have structured-output schemas (JSON keys, types) for the top 3 flows?
- Any network or proxy restrictions we should know for the load test (IP ranges, egress rules)?

Proposed windows next week (PT):
- Wed Jul 14, 10:00–12:00 (preferred for our infra team)
- Thu Jul 15, 13:00–15:00 (fallback)

We also suggest a 30-minute pre-check at 09:15 on the day of the load test to validate access and keys (we'll confirm the dedicated pool we'll use). I attached a checklist for that too.

Attached: prompt-inventory-template.xlsx (please fill at least the top 10 prompts), load-test-checklist.md

If those windows work, I'll send a calendar invite and a short agenda.

Thanks,
Hannah

Hi Hannah — thanks for the clear outline. Wed 14 Jul 10:00 PT looks best for us. Marcus (Product) and our DevOps alias will join.

A couple of notes from our side:
- We'll populate the top prompts in your template and share by EOD Fri Jul 10.
- Structured output schemas: Marcus will attach JSON samples where available.
- Network: our ops team uses a static egress NAT; I'll have them confirm the IP ranges in a follow-up to devops@netzo.com.

Can you confirm you have any quota needs or whether we should expect elevated request rates during the load test? Also good to know if Redwood needs any firewall whitelisting.

Hannah
